name: Acme Widget Controller - Demo Regression
description: A fictional device used to demonstrate teraterm-qa-runner. Replace with your own suite.

setup.instruct: Connect the controller to the serial port and power it on. Wait for the green LED.

tests.title: Firmware version is reported
tests.verify: Verify the output shows firmware 2.4.1 and a build date.

tests.title: Self-test passes after reboot

steps.instruct: Press and release the RESET button on the front panel.

tests.verify: Verify every self-test line reads OK and the status LED is solid green.

tests.title: Uptime counter restarts
tests.verify: Verify the uptime is under two minutes.

tests.title: Default network settings
tests.verify: Verify DHCP is enabled and an address is assigned.

tests.title: Static address can be applied
tests.verify: Verify the controller reports 192.0.2.10 and the link LED stays on.

tests.title: Ping from a workstation succeeds

steps.instruct: From a workstation on the same network run: ping 192.0.2.10

tests.verify: Verify all replies are received with no packet loss.

tests.title: DHCP can be restored
tests.verify: Verify net show reports DHCP enabled and a leased address.

tests.title: Each LED colour can be set
tests.verify: Verify the status LED showed green, then amber, then red.

tests.title: LED blink rate follows the setting
tests.verify: Verify the LED blinks about once per second.

tests.title: Configuration export to USB

steps.instruct: Insert a FAT32 USB stick into the front port.

tests.verify: Verify a success message appears and widget.conf exists on the stick.

tests.title: Configuration import from USB
tests.verify: Verify the import succeeded and the status shows no errors.

tests.title: Factory reset clears the configuration

steps.instruct: This erases the configuration. Make sure the export from STO-001 exists first.

tests.verify: Verify network settings are back to defaults.

teardown.instruct: Remove the USB stick and power down the controller.
